# `image` (Content)

<!-- GENERATED by `dart run tool/reference.dart`. Do not edit. -->

An image (PNG, JPG, GIF, WebP or SVG) from a URL (http...) or an app file. Put app files in `examples/my_own_app/app/views/style/images/` and use the path: `src: examples/my_own_app/app/views/style/images/logo.svg`.

| Prop | Kind | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `src` | text |  |
| `width` | literal |  |
| `height` | literal |  |
| `fit` | literal | cover, contain, fill, fitWidth, fitHeight |
| `radius` | literal |  |

Kinds are explained in REFERENCE.md (Widgets). Icons, colors and text variants: style.md.
